_comment: Mermaid diagrams converted at build time; everything else stays on Mermaid. index = position among the page's ```mermaid blocks. Packets run on edges marked `e1@{ animate: true }` in the Mermaid source. scenarios: a toggle per diagram; fail = links that go down (red, X, packets drop), idle = links that carry nothing while it is down, reroute = backup links that carry the traffic instead, note = what the reader should see. A sequence entry with packetWalk walks one packet through the messages in order.

diagrams.why: MRC multi-plane: subgraph + circles + fan-in; per-packet spraying

scenarios.label: Fail NIC port 8
scenarios.note: Port 8 down: plane 8 goes dark and packets keep spraying over the other planes. The node loses one port's bandwidth (≈12%), the job keeps running.

diagrams.why:
decision diamonds,
labels, labelled edges (static: not a data path)
dotted labelled edges; replicated copies fan out (control-plane edges stay static)
subgraph direction, open/dotted edges, style fills
TI-LFA worked example: protected link and post-convergence repair path

scenarios.label: Fail link S–N
scenarios.note: S–N down: S (the PLR) repairs at once onto the post-convergence path S→A→B→C→D, adding RL = ⟨Node-SID(B), Adj-SID(B→C)⟩. No wait for IGP convergence.
